hero.title: Partner With Us
hero.subtitle: We collaborate with governments, businesses, and institutions to build a more inclusive society for persons with disabilities.

programmesSection.label: What We Do
programmesSection.title: Our Flagship Programmes
programmesSection.subtitle: Four core initiatives driving disability inclusion, education, and sustainable livelihoods.

programmes.title: Disability Rights Initiative Project (DRIP)
programmes.description: A flagship advocacy programme dedicated to promoting and protecting the rights of persons with disabilities. DRIP works with government institutions, civil society, the private sector, and communities to advance disability-inclusive policies, strengthen the implementation of disability laws, and create an inclusive society where everyone can participate equally.

programmes.title: Campaign for an Inclusive Society
programmes.description: A nationwide awareness and advocacy campaign that challenges stigma, promotes accessibility, and fosters equal opportunities for persons with disabilities through public education, community engagement, and strategic partnerships.

programmes.title: EduAbility (Through Scholarship)
programmes.description: An education support initiative that provides scholarships, educational resources, and mentorship for children and young people with disabilities, ensuring they have access to quality education and opportunities to succeed.

programmes.title: GreenAbility
programmes.description: A sustainable development programme that empowers persons with disabilities through climate-smart agriculture, green entrepreneurship, environmental conservation, and livelihood opportunities that promote economic independence.

services: Organizational Capacity Building on Disability Inclusion
partnersBlurb: We partner with governments, businesses, development agencies, NGOs, educational institutions, and community organizations to create inclusive environments where everyone has the opportunity to thrive. As part of that work, BethGold Foundation also serves as EnAble India's regional coordinating partner for Discovery Award Africa, an annual initiative recognizing grassroots, low-cost innovations created by and for persons with disabilities.
